# markdown-it 15.0.3

Browser UMD bundle from the official npm package `markdown-it@15.0.3`, file `dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js`, stored locally as `markdown-it.min.js`.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.3.tgz

Project: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it

The MIT license is included in `LICENSE`. No runtime CDN or npm installation is required. Chat uses raw HTML disabled, images disabled, and the parser's default URL validation.
